findings.detail: The schedule anchor includes 196,401,848 of Level 1 mutual funds outside the private-position extract; subtracting them exactly reconciles the extract.

rationale: The filing reports total investment fair value of 2,487,588,823. It separately reports Level 1 investments of 196,401,848, comprising money market mutual funds of 16,951,323 and fixed income mutual funds of 179,450,525. Subtracting those public-fund positions yields 2,291,186,975, exactly the extracted private-position sum. The residual therefore reflects an over-broad schedule anchor, not missing or erroneous private-position fair value.
